Transductive AE21 was trained for600 steps, while both masked families used1300 steps (the frozen per-objective transfer-median rule). Capacity, data, initialization and optimizer are matched, but this is not an equal-optimization-step transductive comparison; differences cannot be attributed to masking alone.

The first evaluation attempt was externally terminated with SIGTERM/exit143 after29000 records, without a Python traceback or completed evaluator ledger/output. The exact cause remains unconfirmed. Evaluation was technically replayed outside the sandbox using the same pinned evaluator and frozen predictions, with GNU time accounting; no fit restart or numerical change was introduced. The aborted attempt incurs a conservative900 CPU-second budget charge, not a measured CPU duration; its wall upper bound also includes time outside evaluation.
interpretation_notes: Coverage counts assigned sampling windows, not molecule detection recall.
Copied measurement baselines preserve their original21/22 JSON provenance; the25 index/copy ledger links them to this trial.
Relation support overlap uses effective support with margin; assignment support uses the feature crop.
Scalar input normalization is frozen; gallery per-frame contrast is display only.
